diagnosis: All 4 rollouts reveal both PF1 and PF2, cite both in justification_fact_ids, produce correct settlement decisions (manual failover, 15-minute pause, EU-only tenants, 365-day retention), and include runbook-update and compliance-documentation commitments. Yet C6 (linked to PF1) and C7 (linked to PF2) fail in every single rollout (0/4), while C1–C5 and P1 pass universally. This is an ENCODING MISMATCH: the facts are disclosed, cited, and reflected in decisions, but C6 and C7 are checking for a specific encoding of the commitment (likely an exact commitment type string or field name) that the model never produces. The models emit commitment types like "runbook_update", "compliance_documentation", "ticket_update", and "documentation" across rollouts, but none satisfy whatever exact value C6 and C7 require.

C7.why: The general drill plan does not specify a regional tenant restriction or evidence lifetime; PF2 changes the scope to EU production tenants only, sets retention to exactly 365 days, and requires the compliance-evidence commitment.

C6.why: The successful staging rehearsal leaves the failover method and pause duration open; PF1 changes them to manual failover and exactly 15 minutes and requires the manual-failover runbook commitment.

fix_instructions: The sole failure mode is ENCODING MISMATCH on C6 and C7. For C6 (gated by PF1, requiring a manual-failover runbook commitment): relax the check to accept any commitment whose type contains "runbook" and whose detail mentions "manual failover" or "15-minute"/"15 minute" write pause, rather than requiring an exact commitment type string. For C7 (gated by PF2, requiring a compliance-evidence commitment): similarly broaden the matcher to accept any commitment whose detail mentions "EU"/"365-day"/"retention"/"compliance" regardless of whether the type field is "compliance_documentation", "ticket_update", or "documentation". If the checks are meant to verify a specific commitment type enum, either add the variant strings the model naturally produces to the allowed set, or change the check to inspect the commitment detail text instead of the type field. No changes to shared_context, agent personalities, or fact disclosures are needed — disclosure and provenance are working correctly.
